cortex: candidate false successes = 0 on the heldout set
verified not significantly lower than the incumbent's: paired exact McNemar (two-sided, alpha 0.05, scorecard.judge)
proposals per verified fix OR cost per verified fix (generation + ranker + audit, scorecard metrics) strictly lower
rule.axon_loop: admission ACCEPT under quality_margin / economic_threshold below, exact bounds, unknown outcomes count against the candidate
rule.decision: PROMOTE iff axon-loop admits ACCEPT AND every cortex criterion holds; otherwise REJECT (or INCONCLUSIVE when axon-loop says so)
rule.evidence: exactly one scorecard run per arm, both added to the history AFTER this plan's commit (promote.py refuses otherwise)

axon_loop.why: 110000 ppm is just above 5/47: the largest one-directional verified drop exact McNemar (alpha 0.05) cannot detect at n=47 is 5 tasks, so the two quality gates agree; costs are list-price estimates, so axon-loop economics report only and the cost criterion lives in the cortex rule

notes: DRY RUN, zero cost. Incumbent arm: --generator oracle with Cortex's defaults; candidate arm: --generator none with CORTEX_AUDIT=off (verifies nothing). Exercises the REJECT path; decides nothing about Cortex.
